profile.Civilian Name: Serena Moon (Singapore Identity); Tsukino Runa 月野 るな (Japan Identity)
profile.Strengths: Powerful ranged magic, precise energy control, adaptability, offensive light manipulation, healing, combat experience, magical endurance, teamwork, mentorship, observation, and rapid decision-making.
profile.Weaknesses: Large-scale lunar attacks consume significant magical energy. Performing complex healing while maintaining offensive pressure can strain her concentration. Her strong attachment to loved ones may occasionally influence her judgement when they are threatened.
profile.Fear: Losing someone she loves despite centuries of experience and the power to help them.
profile.Disciple: Luma Pink Moon, Luma Perigee, Luma Phase, Luma Gibbous, Luma Lunar; Luma Blossom (unofficial)
profile.Stationed at: Japan; formerly spent an extended period in Singapore.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Sun, Luma Lumen, Luma Blossom, Luma EmberFlora, members of Celestials, and her disciples.
profile.Loves: Her husband, her disciples, peaceful nights, watching younger Guardians grow, and spending time with people she considers family.
profile.Likes: Moonlit scenery, astronomy, celebrations, magical experimentation, teaching, beautiful accessories, and visiting familiar places.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessary conflict, reckless decisions, seeing her disciples discouraged, and people treating less experienced Guardians as expendable.
profile.Hates: Cruelty, exploitation, deliberate harm to innocent civilians, and the abuse of Guardian powers.
profile.Hobbies: Stargazing, collecting moon-themed ornaments, exploring cafés, reading, teaching new magical techniques, and spending time with her husband.
profile.Catchphrase: "Even the darkest night has its light."
profile.Personality: Moon is warm, expressive, and compassionate, with a youthful enthusiasm that occasionally makes others forget how experienced she truly is. She enjoys interacting with younger Guardians and prefers encouraging them through reassurance, demonstrations, and practical experience rather than intimidation. Although approachable and affectionate, Moon becomes exceptionally focused during dangerous missions, revealing centuries of combat knowledge and precise magical control. She strongly values teamwork and believes that Guardians become more capable when they learn to trust one another. As a mentor, she encourages creativity and helps disciples discover techniques that complement their individuality instead of merely copying established methods. Moon also possesses a more serious side shaped by centuries of responsibility, particularly when the safety of her disciples or husband is involved. She respects Lumen deeply and has adopted many of her mentor's principles, although her own teaching style is considerably more expressive.
